items.title: Broadcom (AVGO) Faces Rising Hedge Fund Caution
items.summary: Hedge funds trimmed or exited positions in Broadcom (NasdaqGS: AVGO) in Q2 2026, rotating capital into other large semiconductor and tech stocks. Managers cited concerns around Broadcom's valuation, customer concentration, and margin pressures despite strong AI semiconductor revenue growth.
